reused_axial.counting: One existing family; force/displacement configurations are not additional problems

qualification_rule: Exact equality of rational closed-form and independently assembled solutions for each claimed observable
numeric_claim_rule: Absolute error <= one binary64 ULP of the correctly rounded exact reference, inclusive; serialization agreement only

cases.parameter_origin: Repository-authored development example using published beam theory; not a published numerical benchmark
cases.loading_convention: Uniform transverse dead load q along +w over the entire span; x=0 clamped (w=0, slope=0); x=L free of point force and couple
assumptions: Uniform rectangular section with height in bending direction
Euler-Bernoulli small-slope bending; shear deformation excluded
No axial load, self-weight beyond specified q, inertia, thermal strain or initial curvature
Ideal clamp; nominal beam-section stress, excluding local clamp concentration
No strength, yield, fatigue, buckling or safety decision

claims.meaning: Signed transverse displacement w(L), positive with q
Magnitude of extreme-fiber nominal normal bending stress at x=0
Signed support couple, positive work-conjugate to slope dw/dx

cases.parameter_origin: FLD02 continuum boundary-value problem; no MFiX solver or published output imported
cases.loading_convention: Prescribed uniform T at x=0 and x=L; remaining faces perfectly insulated; flux positive along +x
assumptions: No internal heat generation, advection or radiation
Slab height matches FLD02; flux is per unit area, so no depth or total heat-rate claim
No contact resistance; exact Dirichlet face temperatures
No transient, physical material qualification or apparatus prediction

claims.meaning: Signed axial heat flux, positive toward x=L
